The '''Oricho sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], bordering [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]]. The two sectors met at the [[Cowl Crucible]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lahara seceded, but Oricho remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
